description: This file defines a custom exception class 'GeoRoutesException' for handling errors related to the Amazon Location Service Routes V2 within the AWS SDK for PHP. It extends the generic 'AwsException' class from the AWS SDK.

classes.name: GeoRoutesException
classes.description: A specialized exception class for errors encountered while interacting with the Amazon Location Service Routes V2.

methods.description: Inherits constructor from 'AwsException'. No additional methods are defined.
